featured_reviews.review_text:

At the same time, his guidance is always present — quiet, observant, and deeply thoughtful. This beautiful balance makes every session feel safe, inspiring, and meaningful.
I sincerely wish that many more parents and children find their way to this class and experience the magic it holds. I truly believe that the word heart carries art within it, and when art is nurtured with such care, the heart naturally becomes happy. If you are looking for a class that touches both skill and soul, Vikrant Sir’s art class is a wonderful place to begin.

I knew I had found a special resin artist when, six months ago, I booked a one-on-one session and received a refund without even asking, because she was unwell on the day of the workshop. That integrity stayed with me.

Yes, a few decor items were missing thanks to my design request, but Trupti is wonderfully jugaadu—resourceful, creative, and always focused on teaching the nuances while keeping the atmosphere light and fun.

If deep, beautiful resin creations are something you’re looking for, Trupti is definitely the artist and facilitator to go to.

Thank you, Trupti, for making this experience so memorable.

featured_reviews.name: Vipul Mehra
featured_reviews.review_text:
I visited the legendary Sir J.J. School of Arts for a weekend sketch meet-up with Urban Sketchers Mumbai. The campus is dotted with sculptures and paintings created by students, quietly inhabiting every corner. Lush trees, the presence of many birds, and a heritage building—likely over a century old—give the place a timeless charm.
There is something about this institute that words struggle to capture. It seems to breathe artistic energy and passion. As I walked through the campus, I saw students deeply immersed in sculpting stone, shaping wood, and carving logs. Watching them so absorbed in their work felt like witnessing yogis in meditation—unaware of passersby, untouched by the world around them.
This heritage institute has nurtured some of the finest artists and architects in the country. Though I never had the fortune of studying here, I have learned immensely about art through colleagues and friends who are graduates of this institution.
